title: Riders on the ridge

stage.nudge: The watch at the gate is pointing at something.
stage.bring: the scouts of a coming attack are seen this morning, before the night

text: {watchman} points you to riders on the ridge, watching the town and not hiding it. "Scouts. {arrival}, coming tonight or tomorrow, I'd swear it."

choices.label: Take the warning to the head of the place
choices.deed: carried the warning of {arrival} to the head of the place

effects.text: The head of the place hears you out, and the gate will be barred tonight.
You stand the hour together. The riders go at last; {watchman} won't forget you stood with them.

choices.label: It's no business of yours
choices.deed: kept out of the town's danger
